craft_notes: Sthāyin: bhakti-vīra of bowing; vyabhicāri bhaktyutsāha at churn-essence. Sanskrit-first: manthana-nāman (CHURN-NAMED — kept; names, not churns); ekarasa (ONE-SAP — kept; world's one sap). Rows: 7 declined — no vocative; bowing IS the address (‘I bow’ acts), 1 (‘one sap’ closes — unity last). Close: ‘the world’s one sap’. Rupture: semicolon (abiding stated, then bowed — powers abide, bearer bowed). Rejected: ‘churning’ — killed: churn-named names; ‘essence’ for sap — killed: rasa kept sap (juice, not abstraction). Read aloud: un-HIN-dered, IN the-SELF-made-LORD, GREAT-lord, WIDE-pow-ers a-BIDE … THAT-pow-er-BEAR-er I-bow — GOD, churn-NAMED, THE-world's ONE-sap.

lines: Unhindered, in the self-made Lord, great Lord, wide powers abide;
that power-bearer I bow — god, churn-named, the world's one sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anargala svātmamaye maheśe tiṣṭhanti | taṃ śaktimantaṃ praṇamāmi devaṃ manthānasaṃjñaṃ jagadekasāram

reads_against.argmap: Whom bow, unobstructed? → Abiding powers; churn-named essence bowed.
